# Neomyth

> Modular AI toolkit — voice, document parsing, and specification tools.

## Available tools

- Neo-Voice: Real-time voice assistant (STT → LLM → TTS). URL: /voice

## Coming soon

- Neo-Parse: Extract structure and insights from documents.
- Neo-Spec: Generate and refine technical specifications with AI.

## Getting started

1. Run Docker workers (vLLM, Whisper STT, Kokoro TTS).
2. Start the Neomyth API on port 5000.
3. Open the web app and select Neo-Voice.
